```{r, fig.height=8, fig.width=15}
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# --- data ---
train <- read_csv("train_results.csv") %>% mutate(dataset = "Train")
test  <- read_csv("test_results.csv")  %>% mutate(dataset = "Test")

results_long <- bind_rows(train, test) %>%
  mutate(
    epoch = as.integer(epoch),
    label = factor(label, levels = c("positive", "neutral", "negative"))
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(precision, recall, f1), names_to = "metric", values_to = "score")

epoch_ticks <- sort(unique(results_long$epoch))

# --- aesthetics ---
metric_cols <- c(precision = "#20639B", recall = "#F6AE2D", f1 = "#2CB978")

dataset_lty <- c(Train = "solid", Test = "dashed")

p <- ggplot(results_long,
            aes(x = epoch, y = score, color = metric, linetype = dataset)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(size = 2.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ label, nrow = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = metric_cols, name = "Metric") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = dataset_lty, name = "Dataset") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = epoch_ticks, minor_breaks = NULL,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.02))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0.70, 1.00),
    breaks = seq(0.70, 1.00, by = 0.05),
    minor_breaks = NULL,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.04))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Model Performance per Class",
    subtitle = "Precision, Recall and F1 across Epochs and Dataset",
    x = "Epoch",
    y = "Score"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    # Grid and spacing
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey85", linewidth = 0.4),
    panel.spacing = unit(10, "pt"),
    # Title & subtitle formatting
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, vjust = 2, color = "#222222"
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 13, hjust = 0.5, color = "grey30", margin = margin(b = 15)
    ),
    # Legend styling
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.justification = "center",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13)
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(order = 1, override.aes = list(linetype = 0, linewidth = 3)),
    linetype = guide_legend(order = 2, keywidth = 2)
  )

print(p)

# Optional export
ggsave("metrics_facet_plot.png", p, width = 18, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```


```{r, fig.height=8, fig.width=15}
# ---- libraries ----
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(jsonlite)
library(stringr)

# ---- read JSON ----
j <- fromJSON("conf_matrix_data.json", simplifyVector = TRUE)

# ---- extract all confusion matrices (robust to list or matrix) ----
keys <- grep("^confusion_matrix_epoch_\\d+(?:_train)?$", names(j), value = TRUE)

cm <- map_dfr(keys, function(k) {
  m <- str_match(k, "^confusion_matrix_epoch_(\\d+)(?:(_train))?$")
  epoch   <- as.integer(m[1,2])
  dataset <- ifelse(!is.na(m[1,3]) && m[1,3] == "_train", "Train", "Test")

  x <- j[[k]]
  mat <- if (is.list(x)) do.call(rbind, x) else as.matrix(x)  # <-- FIX
  storage.mode(mat) <- "numeric"

  # sanity: expect 2x2
  stopifnot(nrow(mat) == 2, ncol(mat) == 2)

  class_labels <- c("fake", "real")

  tibble(
    epoch = epoch,
    dataset = dataset,
    true_label = factor(class_labels, levels = class_labels)
  ) |>
    bind_cols(as_tibble(mat, .name_repair = ~ paste0("pred_", class_labels))) |>
    pivot_longer(starts_with("pred_"),
                 names_to = "pred_label", values_to = "n") |>
    mutate(pred_label = factor(sub("^pred_", "", pred_label),
                               levels = class_labels))
})

# ---- row-normalize ----
cm_prop <- cm |>
  group_by(dataset, epoch, true_label) |>
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) |>
  ungroup()

# ---- color palette ----
fill_low  <- "#E8EEF4"
fill_high <- "#4169E1"

# ---- combined plot (Train/Test as rows, Epoch as columns) ----
p_cm <- ggplot(cm_prop, aes(pred_label, true_label, fill = prop)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", prop)),
            color = "#111111", size = 3.6) +
  facet_grid(dataset ~ epoch,
             labeller = labeller(epoch = function(x) paste0("Epoch ", x))) +
  scale_fill_gradient(limits = c(0,1), low = fill_low, high = fill_high,
                      name = "Proportion") +
  labs(
    title = "Confusion Matrices per Epoch",
    subtitle = "Row-normalized (True = rows, Pred = columns)",
    x = "Predicted label",
    y = "True label"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 17, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 8))
  )

# ---- Train plot ----
p_train <- cm_prop %>%
  filter(dataset == "Train") %>%
  ggplot(aes(pred_label, true_label, fill = prop)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", prop)), color = "#111111", size = 3.6) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ epoch,
    nrow = 1,
    labeller = labeller(epoch = function(x) paste0("Epoch ", x))
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    low = fill_low,
    high = fill_high,
    name = "Proportion"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Train Confusion Matrices (Row-normalized)",
    x = "Predicted",
    y = "True"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_blank(),              # <-- removes background
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 10)  # centered title
  )

# ---- Test plot ----
p_test <- cm_prop %>%
  filter(dataset == "Test") %>%
  ggplot(aes(pred_label, true_label, fill = prop)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", prop)), color = "#111111", size = 3.6) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ epoch,
    nrow = 2,
    ncol = 3,
    labeller = labeller(epoch = function(x) paste0("Epoch ", x))
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    low = fill_low,
    high = fill_high,
    name = "Proportion"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Test Confusion Matrices (Row-normalized)",
    x = "Predicted",
    y = "True"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_blank(),              # <-- removes background
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)  # centered title
  )

# ---- save plots (optional) ----
ggsave("confmat_combined.png", p_cm, width = 14, height = 7, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
if (any(cm_prop$dataset == "Train"))
  ggsave("confmat_train.png",  p_train, width = 5, height = 2.7, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
if (any(cm_prop$dataset == "Test"))
  ggsave("confmat_test.png",   p_test,  width = 6.66, height = 4.66, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

```{r, fig.height=8, fig.width=15}
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

# ---- Load data ----
loss <- read_csv("train_losses.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  arrange(step)

# ---- Colors ----
col_line  <- "#1B4F72"   # dark steel blue for loss curve
grid_col  <- "#D9D9D9"
axis_col  <- "#333333"

# keep first point + every 10th for readability
loss_plot <- loss %>% arrange(step) %>%
  filter(row_number() == 1 | row_number() %% 5 == 0)

col_line <- "#1B4F72"; grid_col <- "#D9D9D9"; axis_col <- "#333333"

# data for the clipped first point (only if it's above 1.5)
first_hi <- loss_plot %>% slice(1) %>% filter(train_loss > 1.5)
x_offset <- 180
epoch_steps <- c(842, 1684, 2526, 3368, 4210, 5052)

p <- ggplot(loss_plot, aes(step, train_loss)) +
  geom_line(color = col_line, linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = epoch_steps,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "#000000",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
   # Label each epoch boundary
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = epoch_steps,
    y = 0.7,                     # slightly above y-limit
    label = paste("Epoch", 1:6),
    angle = 0,                   # vertical labels
    vjust = 0,
    hjust = 2.2,
    size = 3.5,
    color = "#000000"
  ) +
  # display range capped, but keep data for annotations/statistics
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 0.7)) +
  labs(
    title = "Training Loss Over Steps",
    subtitle = "Every 5th step shown.",
    x = "Step", y = "Training loss"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = grid_col, linewidth = 0.4),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = axis_col, linewidth = 0.6),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = axis_col, linewidth = 0.6),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "grey30", margin = margin(b = 8))
  )

# ---- Optional: save figure ----
ggsave("training_loss_plot.png", p, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```



```{r, fig.height=10, fig.width=50}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(scales)

best_trial <- 4  # set your best trial id here

# Read & prepare
df <- read_csv("eval_loss_full.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    trial = as.integer(trial),
    trial_lab = factor(paste0("Trial ", trial),
                       levels = paste0("Trial ", sort(unique(trial))))
  ) %>%
  arrange(trial, step)

# Classify trials: pruned = no step 500, best = trial == best_trial, else normal
trial_types <- df %>%
  group_by(trial) %>%
  summarise(pruned = !any(step == 500), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(type = case_when(
    trial == best_trial ~ "Best trial",
    pruned              ~ "Pruned trial",
    TRUE                ~ "Normal trial"
  ))

df <- df %>% left_join(trial_types, by = "trial") %>%
  mutate(type = factor(type, levels = c("Normal trial", "Pruned trial", "Best trial")))

type_cols <- c(
  "Normal trial" = "#1B4F72",  # blue (stable baseline)
  "Pruned trial" = "#e66101",  # orange (warning)
  "Best trial"   = "#33a02c"   # green (success)
)

# Plot
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = step, y = eval_loss, color = type, group = trial)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ trial_lab, nrow = 6, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = type_cols, name = "Trial type") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.02))) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, max(df$eval_loss, na.rm = TRUE))) +
  labs(
    title = "Evaluation Loss per Trial",
    subtitle = "Loss over steps, faceted by trial",
    x = "Step",
    y = "Evaluation Loss"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#D9D9D9", linewidth = 0.4),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line  = element_line(color = "#333333", linewidth = 0.6),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "#333333", linewidth = 0.6),
    axis.text  = element_text(color = "#222222"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "#222222", face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, color = "#222222"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, hjust = 0.5, color = "grey30", margin = margin(b = 8)),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#222222"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

# Optional: save
ggsave("eval_loss_faceted.png", p, width = 22, height = 22, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```
